newsitem.title: USA: Keystone acquires retirement planning co.
newsitem.headline: Keystone acquires retirement planning co.

text.p: Keystone Financial Inc said Friday it had entered an agreement to acquire MMC&P Retirement Benefit Services Inc of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
Terms of the deal were undisclosed.
Keystone Financial is financial holding company that offers trust and investment management services as well as traditional banking services.
MMC&P provides retirement planning consultation to businesses in Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Ohio and New York.
Keystone said MMC&P President John Parks would continue in his role and also assume responsibility for managing Keystone's employee benefits trust business.
